Ability to read and interpret detailed guidelines, procedures, drawings, and specifications. Professional Engineering License is desirable. review_candidates.description: The Opportunity We're seeking ambitious and driven people who are ready to take a step up in their career, whether you're new or established in sales. Join a high-performing team winning business across APAC, as they serve the needs of their clients in a global market. An environment that will demand a lot, but in turn will return your efforts in spades - you'll be coached on a daily basis until you're running you're own book and in control of what you earn. Mindset: Finance and sales skills can be taught but ambition, drive, and emotional intelligence can't. Communication: You'll excel at engaging clients over the phone and building strong relationships. Competitive Spirit: Outbound sales isn't easy - that's why those that do it are well remunerated because if it was easy, everybody would do it. Who are they? Our client is a global fintech company specialising in international payments, foreign exchange, and financial solutions that help businesses trade and grow across borders. They provide an integrated platform for managing cross-border payments, currency risk, cash flow, and financing. With around 25,000 clients worldwide processing over 1.6 million payments annually, they're a significant player in this global space - they operate in 30 markets across 45 offices. The role *Sales and / or Finance experience is not a prerequisite* End-to-End Sales: Manage the entire sales process - from building a pipeline to closing deals and managing client relationships. C-Suite Engagement: Engage with decision-makers from small to medium-sized businesses ($10m-$250m turnover) in meaningful commercial conversations. Problem Solving: Dive deep into your clients' businesses to identify pain points and provide tailored solutions. Continuous Learning: Collaborate closely with strategists and analysts, learning how to develop and present valuable risk management solutions. What's on offer Package : Starting salary $82,500 AUD, average OTE in Y1 $110,000-130,000 AUD. Professional Growth: Daily development sessions with the Country Manager, who's experienced in high-performing sales businesses. Feedback will be focused around sales skills and approach, as well as industry knowledge. A Sales Team with High Standards: Thrive in a driven, fast-paced sales environment where standards are kept high on a daily basis. Long-term Opportunities: While the start will be fast and challenging, they promote and reward from within, providing the opportunity to establish yourself within a global financial services business.
